sources.label: Urban List - Best Restaurants in Bondi

blocks.text: If you just want the shortlist: my picks for the best restaurants in Bondi Beach are [Icebergs Dining Room and Bar](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/icebergs-dining-room-and-bar) for a special occasion with a view, [Sean's](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/seans) for understated produce-driven cooking, [North Bondi Fish](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/north-bondi-fish) for beachfront seafood, and [Totti's](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/tottis-bondi) for a long Italian lunch. Below I break those down by the kind of meal you're after. I write as a local curator rather than claiming to have eaten at every one this week, so book the big names ahead and confirm days and hours on each venue's own site before a special trip.

blocks.title: A living guide
blocks.text: Restaurants change - menus, chefs and trading days shift, and the best tables book out early. I last reviewed this in August 2026; for current hours, prices and bookings, always check the venue's own channels before you go rather than trusting any number in an older guide.
Best for a special occasion
Icebergs Dining Room and Bar

Icebergs is the Bondi bucket-list dinner - a glamorous, glass-walled Italian dining room on the southern cliff, looking straight down over the Icebergs pool and the ocean. It's polished coastal Italian with one of the best outlooks in Sydney. Best for a celebration or impressing visitors; it sits at the premium end, so book well ahead. For more restaurants in this vein, see our round-up of the [best date-night restaurants in Bondi](/bondi-eat-and-drink/date-night-bondi-beach). You can pair it with a look at the [Icebergs pool and where to swim](/where-to-swim-at-bondi-beach).
Sean's

A genuine Bondi institution: chef Sean Moran has run this small, produce-led restaurant on Campbell Parade since 1993 (these days simply "Sean's", formerly Sean's Panorama). The short, hand-written menu changes with what's good, much of it from the chef's own farm. It's understated and beloved rather than flashy - best for a considered, ingredient-first dinner or weekend lunch. It's a small room, so booking is wise.
Beachfront seafood
North Bondi Fish

About as beachfront as dining gets - on Ramsgate Avenue at the north end, with the sand almost at the door. The menu is easy-going seafood: sashimi, calamari, tacos, and fish and chips, plus cocktails. Best for a relaxed lunch or early dinner with a view, and a solid choice with kids in tow - it's a natural fit for our [family-friendly places to eat](/bondi-eat-and-drink/family-friendly-bondi-beach). For every table near the water, see our guide to [beachfront and ocean-view dining in Bondi](/bondi-eat-and-drink/waterfront-dining-bondi-beach).
Bondi Trattoria

A long-running, unfussy Italian on Campbell Parade looking across to the beach - [Bondi Trattoria](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/bondi-trattoria) does pasta, pizza and a casual all-day menu that suits a spontaneous meal. Best for an easy, mid-range dinner opposite the sand rather than special-occasion prices.
Italian & share plates
Totti's Bondi

Totti's, behind [The Royal](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/the-royal-bondi) on Bondi Road, is the crowd-pleasing Italian everyone seems to end up at - famous for its pillowy wood-fired bread and generous, family-style plates in a sunny, convivial room. Start with the bread and build the meal around it. Best for a group, a birthday, or a long boozy lunch; it's popular, so book ahead.
LULU

One of the newer names worth knowing, [LULU](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/lulu-bondi) is a Pan-Asian bar and kitchen on Hall Street built around share plates - think Korean fried chicken, fresh sashimi and drinks to match. Best for a livelier, share-and-graze dinner away from the beachfront. As a newer venue, check its trading days before you rely on it.
A few more worth booking

The shortlist above covers the classics, but Bondi's dining has broadened a lot - these are the other tables I'd happily send you to, spanning Greek, char-grill, pizza and ramen. As with the big names, confirm days and hours on each venue's own site before a special trip.

items: [Hurricane's Grill & Bar](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/hurricanes-grill-bar-bondi-beach) - a long-time favourite for char-grilled ribs and steaks, up on Campbell Parade with beach views. Best for a hungry group.
[Kazzi Beach Greek](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/kazzi-beach-greek-bondi) - a big, buzzy modern-Greek room for share plates, seafood and a lively night out.
[Da Orazio Pizza + Porchetta](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/da-orazio-pizza-porchetta) - wood-fired pizza and porchetta in North Bondi; a reliable, easygoing Italian.
[Chaco Ramen](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/chaco-ramen-bondi) - proper ramen and Japanese small plates when you want something warming and casual.
[bills Bondi Beach](/bondi-eat-and-drink/venues/bills-bondi-beach) - the all-day icon known for its ricotta hotcakes; as good for a long breakfast as an easy dinner.

blocks.text: What to know before you go

items: Book ahead for the big ones: Icebergs, Totti's and Sean's fill up, especially for weekend lunch and warm evenings.
Timing: sunset tables with a view (Icebergs, North Bondi Fish) are the most sought-after - reserve early or aim for lunch.

Price: Icebergs and Sean's sit at the premium end; North Bondi Fish, Bondi Trattoria and LULU are more mid-range - and if you're counting pennies, our guide to the [best cheap eats in Bondi](/bondi-eat-and-drink/cheap-eats-bondi-beach) covers the under-the-radar bargains.
Getting there: it's an easy night out on foot or by bus - see [getting to Bondi](/getting-to-bondi) if you're coming from the city.
Make a day of it: line up a swim or the coastal walk first - see [things to do in Bondi](/things-to-do-in-bondi).

blocks.text: Which Bondi restaurant is right for you?

items: Special occasion with a view: Icebergs Dining Room and Bar.
Easy mid-range Italian opposite the beach: Bondi Trattoria.
Group Italian / long lunch: Totti's Bondi.
Livelier newer share plates: LULU (Hall Street).

items.q: What is the best restaurant in Bondi Beach?
items.a: For a special-occasion dinner with a view, Icebergs Dining Room and Bar is the classic pick. For understated, produce-driven cooking, Sean's on Campbell Parade has been a favourite since 1993.

items.q: Where can I eat right on Bondi Beach?
items.a: North Bondi Fish is the most beachfront option, on Ramsgate Avenue at the north end. Icebergs sits above the pool on the southern cliff with the best elevated view. For the full set, see our guide to [beachfront and ocean-view dining](/bondi-eat-and-drink/waterfront-dining-bondi-beach).

items.q: Which Bondi restaurant has the best view?
items.a: Icebergs Dining Room and Bar, looking over the Icebergs pool and the ocean, is hard to beat; North Bondi Fish gets you closest to the sand.

items.q: Do I need to book a Bondi restaurant?
items.a: For Icebergs, Totti's and Sean's, yes - book ahead, especially for weekend lunch and warm evenings. Casual spots like Bondi Trattoria and North Bondi Fish are more forgiving. Confirm current hours on each venue's own site.

blocks.text: Whether it's a big night at Icebergs or fish and chips on the sand, Bondi eats well. For cafés and coffee, see my guide to [Bondi's best cafés and coffee](/bondi-eat-and-drink/best-cafes-bondi-beach); for the rest of your visit, [things to do in Bondi](/things-to-do-in-bondi) and [what's on](/whats-on); and if you're still choosing a base, [where to stay in Bondi](/stay).
